test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option “No replacement required”.

The __**trucculent**__ player argued fiercely with the referee after the decision.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence uses the word **‘trucculent’**, which is misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **‘truculent’**.
 
• The word **‘truculent’** is an adjective that means eager or q
